    def start(self, diff):
        self.name, self.delay = diff
        self.snake = [(COLS // 2, ROWS // 2)]
        self.dir = (1, 0)
        self.pending = []
        self.score = 0
        self.food = self.spawn_food()
        self.state = "play"
        self.draw()
        self.job = self.root.after(self.delay, self.step)

    def spawn_food(self):
        while True:
            p = (random.randrange(COLS), random.randrange(ROWS))
            if p not in self.snake:
                return p

    def step(self):
        if self.state != "play":
            return
        if self.pending:
            self.dir = self.pending.pop(0)
        hx, hy = self.snake[0]
        head = (hx + self.dir[0], hy + self.dir[1])
        if head[0] < 0 or head[0] >= COLS or head[1] < 0 or head[1] >= ROWS or head in self.snake:
            self.game_over()
            return
        self.snake.insert(0, head)
        if head == self.food:
            self.score += 1
            if len(self.snake) >= COLS * ROWS:
                self.game_over(win=True)
                return
            self.food = self.spawn_food()
        else:
            self.snake.pop()
        self.draw()
        self.job = self.root.after(self.delay, self.step)

    def game_over(self, win=False):
        self.state = "over"
        self.job = None
        self.draw()
        msg = "You Win!" if win else "Game Over!"
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(BOARD_W // 2 - 190, BOARD_H // 2 - 60,
                                     BOARD_W // 2 + 190, BOARD_H // 2 + 60,
                                     fill=BLACK, outline=RED, width=2)
        self.text(msg + "  Score: %d" % self.score, 24, RED, BOARD_W // 2, BOARD_H // 2 - 20)
        self.text("R: restart   Q: quit", 15, WHITE, BOARD_W // 2, BOARD_H // 2 + 20)

    def draw(self):
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(1, 1, BOARD_W - 1, BOARD_H - 1, outline=GRAY, width=2)
        fx, fy = self.food
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(fx * CELL + 1, fy * CELL + 1,
                                     (fx + 1) * CELL - 1, (fy + 1) * CELL - 1,
                                     fill=RED, outline=RED)
        for sx, sy in self.snake:
            self.canvas.create_rectangle(sx * CELL + 1, sy * CELL + 1,
                                         (sx + 1) * CELL - 1, (sy + 1) * CELL - 1,
                                         fill=GREEN, outline=GREEN)
        self.text("Score: %d   Difficulty: %s" % (self.score, self.name),
                  14, WHITE, BOARD_W // 2, BOARD_H + 17)
